description: Implement automatic field insertion for date and email fields during document signing. When a user signs a document, the system should automatically populate date fields with the current date and email fields with the signer's email address (when available). This should work across both direct template signing and regular envelope workflows.
functional_requirements: Automatically insert current date into all date fields when a document is signed
Automatically insert the signer's email address into email fields when the email is provided
Ensure field insertion works consistently across both direct template signing and standard envelope workflows
Maintain existing field validation rules while auto-populating fields
Update relevant E2E tests to verify auto-insertion behavior works correctly
Handle cases where email fields exist but no email is provided (skip insertion in those cases)
